title: Question 10
passage:
Does this umbrella stand belong to the café next door?
A. The café stops serving lunch at two. B. Yes, they put it out on rainy days. C. I walked here without an umbrella.
passageZh:
這個傘架是隔壁咖啡館的嗎？
A. 咖啡館兩點停止供應午餐。 B. 是。他們下雨天會把它搬出來。 C. 我是沒帶傘走過來的。
